description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of entity topics within the $M^3EL$ dataset, as described in the paper “A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking.” It is a donut-style chart with five distinct segments, each representing a different topic category: “Movie” (light blue, 41.2%), “Person” (pink, 30.5%), “Common” (light green, 14.9%), “Book” (light yellow, 9.1%), and “Sport” (light purple, 4.3%). A legend positioned in the center of the donut clearly maps each color to its corresponding topic. The segments are arranged clockwise in descending order of proportion, with “Movie” occupying the largest portion and “Sport” the smallest. Percentages are labeled directly on each segment, providing a clear visual and numerical breakdown of the topic distribution across entities in the dataset.
